description: Alert when a product's total drops below a target. Without account: watch (e-mail), status, manage via the mail link token t. Signed in: list, set, update, delete.

action.description: Operation to run; help {topic:"price_watch"} lists each one's arguments

change.description: confirm, pause, resume, set_target or cancel (manage)

t.description: Token t of a watch e-mail link (status, manage)

target_total.description: Target total in shop currency, e.g. 1999; null = any real drop (manage)

name: price_watch
title: Price watches
